policy.execution_rule: software may advance automatically inside active leases and gates; physical/external/public actions require their applicable evidence and authority receipts

tasks.title: Materialise exact S91 Recovery input
tasks.action: Retrieve exact Recovery carrier by authoritative Drive ID; verify SHA-256 before any mutation.
done_when: materialised file SHA-256 equals accepted S91 hash
receipt records source Drive ID, byte size, hash and verifier result

tasks.title: Build PRE_CANONICAL CGP-IES parent descendant
tasks.action: Run build_cgp_ies_parent_candidate.py against exact verified S91; output new carrier only.
done_when: new candidate produced without overwriting S91

tasks.title: Independent parent-candidate acceptance audit
tasks.action: Independently verify DBR continuity, roots, topology, exact extension contents, authority/release refs and pack/reopen hash.
done_when: no Restricted internal authority topology is embedded in public-safe extension source
accept/reject recommendation refers to exact candidate hash

tasks.title: Founder parent-promotion gate
tasks.action: Approve or reject the exact verified candidate hash; if approved, promote exact bytes as next Recovery authority without deleting S91 lineage.
done_when: promoted Recovery exact hash is read back
current Recovery pointer is atomically updated

tasks.title: Regenerate and verify domain children
tasks.action: Regenerate Romer.cgx, Eco.cgx, EMASSC.cgx and LS.cgx from promoted parent.
done_when: all four packed reopen verifiers pass
nested child cannot weaken GATE or ENFORCE_SAFETY

tasks.title: Bind authority-phase receipts into execution leases
tasks.action: Extend execution-lease contract/runtime validation with authority phase, root-authority receipt ref and release receipt ref for applicable actions.
done_when: pre-launch consequential execution requires root-authority receipt reference
public external action requires release receipt reference
expired/revoked authority receipt cannot satisfy lease
tests cover allow and fail-closed cases

tasks.title: Physical multi-device and non-loopback CGX proof
tasks.action: Execute current physical field package on genuinely distinct devices/nodes; capture discovery, sync, identity, lease, revocation and degraded-mode receipts.
done_when: two genuinely distinct physical devices verified
identity and lease scopes read back on both nodes
partition/degraded mode does not create authority

tasks.title: Platform keystore and recovery proof
tasks.action: Verify production-relevant credential storage, revocation and recovery on target host classes without exposing secret material.
done_when: no secret appears in Git/Drive/public receipts
assurance receipt records capability but not secret

tasks.title: Decentralised governance promotion readiness
tasks.action: Evaluate EQG-070 launch formula and exact promoted authority matrix; do not promote while any empirical predicate is open.
done_when: all claim-relevant empirical launch predicates pass
authority matrix is explicit and machine-readable
root-authority promotion receipt identifies exact governance/carrier state

tasks.title: Mark III / Mark V finite-lifecycle pilot
tasks.action: Populate stable IDs, beneficiaries, ceilings, MVSL, material/hazard passport, stop/passivation/restart and inheritance fields from current owning evidence.
done_when: no design claim is promoted by template fill

tasks.title: Asteroid resource unit equilibrium pilot
tasks.action: Bind extraction need/ceiling, fleet count, replication budget, orbital cascade, hibernation, closure and successor state.
done_when: all required fields populated or OPEN
trajectory/orbit unknowns separated from policy defaults

tasks.title: Eco-Grex intervention pilot
tasks.action: Populate affected-party, ecology, welfare, representation, biosecurity, intervention/reversibility and inheritance fields.

tasks.title: InterSol lifecycle and dependent-life pilot
tasks.action: Populate occupancy classes, life-support MVSL, evacuation/safe haven, abandonment, hibernation, restart, hazard and succession.

tasks.title: Cognigrex self-lifecycle pilot
tasks.action: Apply the same finite-lifecycle envelope to Cognigrex: compute, agent population, evidence/archive, authority, degeneration, hibernation, succession and shutdown.
done_when: Cognigrex can recommend contraction/shutdown where merit fails

tasks.title: Bounded continuous frontier solve
tasks.action: Continuously select highest-value solvable OPEN item, execute bounded derive/simulate/cross-analysis work, reconcile result to owning source, and emit next evidence need.
done_when: each run closes or narrows at least one OPEN item or records a justified no-change
empirical requirements are never synthetically closed
